subject: QBR hiring signals: consolidated asks & frozen-req exception requests
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: QBR hiring signals: consolidated asks & frozen-req exception requests

Team — attaching a single sheet with the headcount signals I pulled from product, infra, and platform. This is meant to be the canonical input for tomorrow's QBR prep: one row per req, current status, business impact, and a suggested ask (open / freeze-exception / backfill immediate).

Key asks from me:
- Can each hiring owner (Markus, Laura, Jonas) mark the priority column and add a one-line business consequence if we hold the role frozen beyond the quarter?
- If you have an exception to the hiring freeze, add it to the "exception rationale" column and attach procurement/finance notes.

Note: I flagged 6 roles that touch customer SLAs and 4 IC roles that can be deferred. I want the final consolidated sheet by EOD tomorrow so I can present a single slide to execs.

Attachments: QBR_Headcount_Signals_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR hiring signals: consolidated asks & frozen-req exception requests

Vanessa — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes on my end:
- I updated two platform infra reqs (PLT-142, PLT-145) to "exception" with a short rationale. Both are latency-reduction roles tied to a committed customer migration; delaying >1 quarter increases SLA risk.
- For the three engineering IC reqs you flagged as "defer", I agree but propose we keep a candidate shortlist for a fast re-open. I've added names in column G.

Question: are we expecting the execs to approve 1) any exception now or 2) only a shortlist so we can budget next quarter? That changes how granular my notes should be.

-Markus
Director, Platform Engineering

Team — thank you for the fast turnaround. Final notes before the QBR deck: 
1) Laura: the updated sheet looks good. Please lock the "final" tab and mark any remaining ambiguous rows with the hiring manager initials so I can call them out.
2) Markus/Jonas: I need an approval line from each of you on the two platform exception reqs by EOD today to include in the exec slide. If not approved, we'll present them as "deferred" with a mitigation plan.
3) Ruth/TP: copy received. We'll send job briefs for any immediate-exception roles by tomorrow morning.

I'll attach a one-slide summary to the QBR deck and circulate once the approvals are in. If you anticipate escalation requests (discounts, contractor budget transfers), please note them in the "exec ask" column.

Thanks — V

Vanessa Ortiz
